heading: Motifs: Full-stack Web App for Undesignable RNA Motifs
subtitle: Web Server Link | Publication Link
content: Developed a full-stack web app to maintain a database of unique minimal undesignable RNA structures and motifs.
Users can explore, visualize, analyze, and identify undesignable motifs in existing and new RNA structures.
Frontend built with React, backend powered by Flask and Express, with MongoDB for data storage.
Deployed using Docker and Nginx for scalability and performance.

heading: LinearAlifold: RNA Alignment and Folding
subtitle: Web Server Link | GitHub Link | Publication Link
content: Developed a dynamic programming algorithm for linear-time consensus RNA structure prediction from alignments.
Implemented beam pruning and multiple energy models to compute MFE, MEA, Threshknot, and stochastic sampling.
Built a web server that allows users to submit sequences and run various structural analyses interactively.

heading: Explore ML Facilitator
subtitle: Certificate Link
content: Conducted five workshops on machine learning, introducing core concepts and practical applications.
Facilitated as part of the Google-sponsored Explore ML program to promote ML education.

heading: Computer Vision for Fras-Le Friction
content: Automated part of the quality control process using a vision-based app for dimensional analysis of brake liners.
Used multiple vision cameras to perform real-time measurements and inspections.

heading: Reinforcement Learning Capstone
subtitle: GitHub Link
content: Built a Deep Q-Learning agent that outperformed humans in Atari Breakout.
The agent discovered high-scoring strategies through reinforcement learning techniques.

heading: Flutter Chess Game
subtitle: Demo Link | GitHub Link
content: Built a chess game using Flutter and C++ with bitboard-based move generation.
Implemented AI opponent using NegaMax and added online multiplayer support.

heading: Teachable Image Classifier
subtitle: GitHub Link
content: Developed a web app allowing non-experts to train image classifiers from scratch.
Supported live sample collection, adjustable training parameters, and real-time feedback.

heading: Vedic Life Foundation Mobile App
content: Built a mobile app for guided meditation, session tracking, and member enrollment.
Included social features like community Q&A, progress tracking, and motivational sharing.
